category: maps, routing, geocoding and traffic API

free_tier.stated: free monthly requests per API, no credit card: 20K Geocoding, 20K Reverse Geocoding and 20K Routing requests a month, 2.5K Search API and 2.5K Matrix Routing requests a month, 200K vector map tiles a month; unused free amounts do not carry over and expire at the end of each month
free_tier.notes: the free use is the evaluation part of a Freemium account, which the FAQ says may be used for commercial applications; Freemium accounts are single-user

per_object_cap.stated: Batch Search takes up to 100 items a synchronous request and 10000 an asynchronous one; asynchronous results can be downloaded for 14 days

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in requests, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS to api.tomtom.com (for example /search/2/geocode/QUERY.json) with an API key created in MyTomTom; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401 'You are missing valid authentication credentials'; requests over a free limit answer HTTP 429. Batch Search takes Geocode, Structured Geocode and Reverse Geocode items
tooling: any HTTP client; Maps SDK for JavaScript and mobile SDKs
chaining: 20K geocodes, 20K reverse geocodes and 20K routes a month with no card, at 5 queries a second; Bulk path: asynchronous Batch Search of up to 10000 geocode items a request, whose count against the free monthly amounts is unverified

limits.value: 20K Geocoding, 20K Reverse Geocoding and 20K Routing requests a month on the free tier
5 queries a second by default for Geocoding, Reverse Geocoding, Routing, Search and Batch Search
results cached only for the maximum age of their cache-control headers; no other storing
10000 items an asynchronous Batch Search request, 100 a synchronous one

binding_note: 5 queries a second would pass a monthly 20K within the first day, so the monthly count is met first

identity_cost.detail: a MyTomTom account registered and confirmed by email; no credit card. The other fields of the registration form are unverified: the sign-in host refused automated reads with HTTP 403

reliability_note: requests over a free limit answer HTTP 429; access made available for evaluation can be terminated at any time without notice; one evaluation subscription plan per account
confidence_note: the pricing page, the terms, the QPS limits page, the platform FAQ, the Batch Search docs and the MyTomTom account docs were quoted on 2026-10-31; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401. The registration form and the batch billing answer of the pricing FAQ were not readable; an account would show both and a keyed request would move it to measured.
